responsibility: Serializes the compiler’s populated CTF container into the final .ctf debug section. It is the CTF back end responsible for section setup, preprocessing and sorting of variable/function/object tables, computation of variable-length record sizes, emission of the CTF header and indexed subsections for objects, functions, variables, types, and strings, and formatting of each concrete CTF record kind’s fixed and variable payload in assembler syntax via dwarf2asm helpers.
